§6Fallout

§aNuclear ash from explosions. Radioactive, but you can extract useful isotopes from it.

§bFallout§f is fission products and neutron-activated materials pulled into the sky by nuclear explosions, then falling back as ash. It also forms from nuclear waste blocks.

§6Behavior§f: Falls like snow as shallow granular layers. Dig with a shovel for piles, compress into blocks for storage. Radioactivity: §e30 RAD/s§f (item form).

§6SILEX Processing§f (BiSmUTh crystal, 9.0x):
• §e90%§f Tiny Pile of Dust
• §e2%§f Cobalt-60 Nugget
• §e3%§f Strontium-90 Powder
• §e1%§f Iodine-131 Powder
• §e3%§f Caesium-137 Powder
• §e1%§f Gold-198 Nugget

§6Uses§f: §bRadiation-Powered Engine§f fuel. The isotopes extracted are more valuable than the fallout itself.

§ePS:§f Sr-90 makes great RTG pellets. Don't let fallout scatter wastefully, collect and process it.
